headline: Build the deep learning foundation for CV and NLP
subheadline: Start with representation learning, project strategy, generative models, and LLM application patterns before branching into vision or language.
summary_markdown: CS230 is the foundation layer for the DL -> CV/NLP learning path. It gives learners the shared deep learning vocabulary and project intuition needed before specializing into CS231n computer vision or CS224n NLP.
learning_outcomes: Understand the core deep learning concepts that connect modern CV and NLP systems
Build intuition for representation learning, generative models, and model behavior
Prepare for branch courses such as CS231n and CS224n with a common DL foundation
target_audience: Learners who want a practical deep learning foundation before specializing in computer vision, NLP, or generative AI applications
prerequisites_summary: Basic Python, linear algebra intuition, and willingness to learn neural network fundamentals
structure_snapshot: Foundation-first course with lecture segments, canonical unit summaries, and quiz-backed checkpoints

headline: Build deep intuition for modern vision systems
subheadline: Learn the path from linear classifiers to transformers, generative models, and multimodal systems.

learning_outcomes: Understand the core architecture families used in computer vision

headline: Explore modern NLP and language modeling workflows
subheadline: Learn word vectors, neural sequence models, transformers, retrieval, generation, agents, and modern language model workflows.
summary_markdown: CS224n is the NLP branch of the DL -> CV/NLP learning path. It builds from representation learning and sequence modeling toward transformers, language models, retrieval, agents, and evaluation.
learning_outcomes: Understand the core NLP modeling stack from word vectors to transformers
Connect language model concepts to retrieval, generation, agents, and evaluation
Use quiz-backed lecture units to build and verify NLP mastery
target_audience: Learners who want to specialize in NLP after a basic deep learning foundation
prerequisites_summary: Python basics, neural network intuition, and ideally core CS230 foundation segments
structure_snapshot: Lecture-first NLP branch with canonical units, summaries, and question-bank checkpoints
